summary:
All three parts of the batch are done in /home/lamter/omnicourses/.claude/worktrees/cv-build-fb on branch cvb/13-admin-screens: four signed commits on a84e934. verify.sh printed RESULT: ALL PASS on the final commit and the working tree is clean. report.md was not written: the Write tool refused it ("Subagents should return findings as text, not write report files"), so the report is in this result, as the brief's last fallback says.

Commit by commit:

1. 386dd14 (part B, calendar presentation). New src/frontend/src/calendar/present.ts holds the kind-to-colour-group table (EVENT_KIND_GROUP), eventTitle(event, lang), otherEventTitle(event, lang) and spanIn(event, format). The helpers take any object with a title and English title, or with start and end dates, so the notification event type fits as well as the calendar event type. calendar/CalendarView.vue, admin/CalendarAdmin.vue and notifications/messages.ts (eventLine) now import it, and the three copies are gone. The two screens keep one-line local wrappers that pass the current language, so their template lines only change KIND_GROUP to EVENT_KIND_GROUP.
   - The empty-English-title question: an empty titleEn cannot reach the client. The create and update request types trim it. The service turns a blank one into null on both create and update. Nothing else in the backend writes academic_calendar (no seed, no raw insert). Notifications copy titleEn from that same column. So all three callers now use the screens' rule: fall back to the Vietnamese title when titleEn is empty or null. Output is the same as before for every value that can arrive.
   - New calendar/present.spec.ts covers this, including the empty-string case.

2. 70a50e1 (part A1). The watch that reloads the program list when grants change moved from CurriculumAdmin and CalendarAdmin into useProgramPicker (admin/store.ts). store.ts now imports useAdminAccess from access.ts; this makes no import cycle. Both screens dropped their now unused useAdminAccess.

3. 5bc7eaf (part A2). New admin/saved-document.ts exports useSavedDocument({scope, scopeKey, read, what, reloadId, failedAs?}).
   - It returns document, status, stale, staleness, onScreen, readSaved, load and showSaved. readSaved, load and showSaved are the old code verbatim, including the newest-only window rules. Scopes are compared by key (programId for the calendar, curriculumId for the curriculum), never as objects. The console messages are the same strings as before.
   - staleness ({reloadId, is, mark}) is passed straight to useAdminDialog. The stale ref stays for the templates.
   - CurriculumAdmin's 'missing' status comes from its own failedAs: not_found maps to 'missing' and, as before, logs nothing. The composable has no flag for it.
   - The option is named read, not fetch, because the lint rule against calling fetch outside the API module flags `fetch(`.
   - New admin/saved-document.spec.ts has 11 tests: newest read wins, off-screen reads, reads whose scope left the screen, matching by key, failed loads and races, the screen's own status, signed_out, the stale transitions, the staleness guard, and no scope. I checked that it bites: removing the newest check, swapping upcoming() for start(), always calling start(), dropping the on-screen re-check, or not clearing stale each makes at least one test fail.
   - Dialogs, forms, messages, the other admin screens, and the screens' own notice, open, finish and problem code are unchanged. CurriculumAdmin.spec, CalendarAdmin.spec and Admin.browser.spec are untouched and pass.

4. fb20c2c (docs). docs/analysis-and-design/class-model.md, frontend folder table: added calendar present.ts and admin saved-document.ts. The commit also adds the empty .changeset/13-admin-screens.md (two lines, `---` and `---`).

Part C: scripts/layers.mjs gains exactly one frontend feature edge, 'notifications -> calendar'. Lint asked for it; no edge was removed.

The survey was wrong on one point: it lists AccessAdmin as a caller of useProgramPicker. It is not; the only callers are CurriculumAdmin, CalendarAdmin and ImportAdmin.

No off-limits file was touched.

report.md in the scratchpad batches folder was not written: the Write tool refused it ("Subagents should return findings as text, not write report files"). I did not get around that with a shell heredoc; the report is in this result instead.
lookTwice: ImportAdmin also calls useProgramPicker, so it now gets the grant-change refresh too. Before, it never reloaded on a grant change. The reload runs only when the program list is loaded and the granted program ids differ from the listed ones, and it is quiet. If the picked program disappears, `program` falls back to the first in the list, the import target changes, and ImportAdmin clears the current preview and any write problem. The chosen CSV file is kept. ImportAdmin.spec passes unchanged. Decide whether this is wanted (in effect a fix) or whether the watch should be opt-in.

There is now one rule for the English title (fall back on empty or null), based on the backend evidence in the summary. If something ever stores '' in title_en directly, for example a SQL insert, notifications would show the Vietnamese title instead of a blank.
Commit trailers read 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>', following the session's attribution instruction, not the brief's 'Claude Fable 5.2'.
useSavedDocument casts its status ref (`ref('loading') as Ref<SavedStatus | X>`) so a screen's extra status, such as 'missing', stays typed.

nonBlocking: src/frontend/src/admin/store.ts:36-41: the grant-refresh watch now lives in useProgramPicker, so ImportAdmin.vue (its third caller) picks it up too. ImportAdmin never had this watch. It now quietly refetches its program list when the admin's program grants change, while the group_links program list is loaded. This is harmless and follows from the brief's step 1. But it is a behaviour change in a screen the brief says must not change. Name it in the report, and optionally pin it with a spec.

src/frontend/src/admin/saved-document.ts:14: the failedAs option and the generic X are used by CurriculumAdmin only. The screen supplies the mapping, so the brief's 'expressed by that screen' is met. Still, only one caller understands this option. Record it in the report as the chosen shape.

The academic_calendar_events.title_en column has no CHECK against an empty string. Only a direct SQL edit could store one. If that happened, notifications would now fall back to the Vietnamese title, where before they showed a blank. The app itself cannot write it.
The composable returns both stale (a ref) and staleness (the dialog guard). This is slightly redundant but fine.
No implementer report.md existed in the scratchpad batches/13-admin-screens folder, so I could not check the stated omissions.
checked: Behaviour, line by line: old and new readSaved/load/showSaved in both screens match. The newest-only window rules are the same: start() is called only when on screen, load uses upcoming(), and the write guard is isNewest?.() && onScreen. Reset order, signed_out silence, the exact console.error texts, and not_found -> 'missing' without a log all match.
onScreen compared by scopeKey gives the same results as the old field comparisons. The staleness reloadIds 'calendar-reload' and 'curriculum-reload' are unchanged.
The grant watch moved into useProgramPicker unchanged.
EVENT_KIND_GROUP is byte-identical to both old tables. eventTitle, otherEventTitle and spanIn are identical to the old helpers. CalendarAdmin datesOf and eventLine render the same output.

An empty titleEn cannot reach the client. Create and update both pass it through nullIfBlank, which trims. No seed or import writes calendar events. Notifications copy title_en from the stored event. So using one falsy rule is correct.
Contract: the diff over openapi.json, migrations and package-lock.json is empty, and no backend file changed.

Tests: only two spec files changed, both new. vitest on admin, calendar and notifications passed 422 of 422. The Admin browser spec passed 17 of 17. The saved-document spec catches the mutations I tried.
Completeness: none of the old copies remain, and class-model.md was updated.
Structure: the import graph gains one edge, notifications -> calendar, which is listed in layers.mjs. There is no cycle. The admin -> calendar edge already existed.
Repo rules: no comments and no new dependency. All four commits are signed (G) with Conventional subjects. There is exactly one new changeset file. Typecheck and lint pass.
Scope: only 12 files changed, and no off-limits file was touched.
